title: MG_HW12: Anvi'o Interactive Protocol
author: Bonnie Hurwitz and Murat Meren
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gg8btzw
materials: Using the previous protocol, fire up the anvio software and navigate to the directory with your contigs db and profiles directories. cd skinmicrobiome

steps.title: Start anvi'o interactive viewer
steps.instruction: Launch the interactive viewer using the following command: anvi-interactive -p SAMPLES-MERGED/PROFILE.db -c contigs.db

steps.title: Create a data summary
steps.instruction: Generate a summary of the data from the command line using the following command: anvi-summarize -p SAMPLES-MERGED/PROFILE.db -c contigs.db -o SAMPLES-SUMMARY -C CONCOCT

steps.title: Visualize and customize the phylogram
steps.instruction: Use the layers tab to draw and refine the circle phylogram.

substeps.instruction: Click the draw button in the layers tab to generate a circle phylogram.
Adjust the view by zooming in and out.
Switch colors for each body site and redraw the figure.
Modify general tree settings (e.g., switch between circle or rectangular displays, change tree radius or width).
Edit layer settings, including margins, custom margins, and display modes (e.g., 'text' or 'color' for categorical; 'bar' or 'intensity' for numerical).
Set normalization ('square-root' or 'log'), minimum/maximum cutoff values, and layer height.
Use the multi-selector at the bottom to apply settings to multiple layers simultaneously.
Load or save states to store visual settings.

steps.title: Manage and analyze bins
steps.instruction: Use the bins tab to load and manipulate metagenomic bins.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Load bin collection' and select 'CONCOCT' from the pop-up window.
Create, delete, or rename bins.
Change bin colors or sort bins by name, number of units, or completion/contamination estimates.
View the number of selected units in a bin and click the unit count button to see the list of names.
Store or load bin collections.

steps.title: Inspect contig data
steps.instruction: Use the mouse tab and right-click functions to explore individual contig information.

substeps.instruction: Mouse over different regions of the graph to see data about individual contigs.
Mouse over different levels of the circles (center to ends) to vary the amount of data displayed.
Right-click on a contig and select 'inspect' to view detailed information, including genes and annotations (kegg and pfam) from the contigs db.
Perform a blast search on the fly via the inspect menu.

steps.title: Evaluate bin taxonomy and completeness
steps.instruction: Assess the quality and taxonomic assignment of the bins.

substeps.instruction: Check the taxonomy for each bin; for bins labeled 'NONE', click the button to identify present taxa.
Navigate to the 'Compl.' tab to view the estimated completeness of bins based on core bacterial gene composition.

steps.title: Configure sample data
steps.instruction: Use the samples tab to manage additional data provided via the samples database.

substeps.instruction: Change the order of layers using the Sample order combo box (automatically-generated or user-provided).
Customize individual samples information entries.

description: For a detailed overview of the anvi'o interactive viewer and all of the things you can do with it. See the weblink below. We will go over major components of the viewer in class. http://merenlab.org/2016/02/27/the-anvio-interactive-interface/
